description: Get the Schedule 13D and 13G beneficial-ownership record of a stock or ETF listing: each filer's latest 13D or 13G, its event date, the block's shares (restated onto today's split basis) and percent of class, the change since the filer's previous 13D or 13G, and every reporting person on the cover pages with their own amount, percent and sole or shared voting and dispositive power. Reporting persons on one filing each claim the same block, so never add them together. Largest block first.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of filers to return (default: 20, clamped to 1-500)

offset.description: Number of filers to skip before returning results (default: 0)

name: GetBeneficialOwnership
title: Stock 13D and 13G Filers
